title: Fix both platforms' refused-camera messages in a new thread, specced and dispatched with mitosis in a fresh session
context: The post-merge live run on 2026-09-29 found that the macOS refused-access fix from PR #237 does not work against the real plugin, and that Android never names a refused permission. The owner confirmed that recording itself works on their Mac ("Recording videos works."), so only the message after a refusal is wrong. The owner then asked: "Create a new logbook thread to spec and fix the camera access issues on both macOS and Android. Record all necessary information to seamlessly pick-up this issues and dispatch fixes in the fresh session. Do NOT pick-up the logbook thread. Park it."
options: Fix both in the session that found them
Park both in a new thread, spec with the interphase bug pathway, dispatch with mitosis in a fresh session
Fold them into the open recorder-android-followups thread
outcome: A new thread, camera-access-messages, covers both platforms. A fresh session specs them with the interphase bug pathway and dispatches the fixes with mitosis as draft PRs, the owner's usual flow. It stays separate from recorder-android-followups because that thread's fixes are recorder semantics and layout, but the two touch neighbouring recorder files, so their branches must be sequenced (risk 01M3NSF3ZKVNES4Q3C3WQ3W2TQ).
